core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9th level, hit dice do not increase; add +2 hit points per level.

general_notes.rule: May use any magic item usable by fighters.
If the paladin changes to Neutral or Chaotic alignment, he loses class powers.
If he later reverts to Lawful alignment and atones for misdeeds, possibly by quest or atonement spell, he can regain lost powers.

weapons.rule: Permitted weapons: battle axe, flail, lance, mace, morning star, pole arm, spear, sword, two-handed sword, war hammer.

fighting_styles.rule: May fight with weapon and shield.
May fight with a weapon two-handed.
May fight with a weapon in each hand.

restrictions.restriction: None beyond weapon list and Lawful alignment requirement.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw starts at 10+ against AC 0.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 every 3 levels.
Base melee and missile damage bonus is +1 at 1st level, with an additional +1 at 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th level.

ability.name: aura_of_protection
ability.summary: Protection against evil creatures.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to AC against attacks made by evil creatures.
Gain +1 bonus on saving throws against effects created by evil creatures.
The aura appears as a golden halo when viewed with detect good, detect magic, or true seeing.

ability.name: sanctified_body
ability.summary: Complete immunity to disease.

rules.rule: Immune to all disease, including magical disease.

ability.name: detect_evil
ability.summary: Detect evil by concentration.

rules.rule: For this power and the paladin's aura, evil creatures include all undead, all summoned creatures, and any Chaotic creatures intending harm to the paladin.
Sinkholes of evil and magic items harmful to Lawful creatures are also detected.

ability.name: lay_on_hands
ability.summary: Heal by touch.

rules.rule: May heal self or another creature.
Heals 2 points of damage per class level per use.

limits.limit: The Laying on Hands proficiency grants additional daily uses.

ability.name: holy_fervor
ability.summary: Inspires followers of the same religion.

rules.rule: Hirelings of the same religion gain +1 morale while the paladin is present.
This bonus stacks with bonuses from Charisma and proficiencies.

ability.name: paladin_lord
ability.summary: May found or capture a fortress and attract followers.

rules.rule: When a fortress is founded or captured, up to 1d4+1x10 0th level mercenaries and 1d6 paladins of 1st-3rd level come seeking jobs and training.
If hired, mercenary followers must be paid standard mercenary rates.
The class stronghold is otherwise mechanically identical to a fighter's castle.

acquisition_rules.rule: May found or capture a fortress and become a protector of men.
The class stronghold is otherwise identical to a fighter's castle.

cost_rules.rule: If hired, mercenaries must be paid standard rates.

entry_restrictions.restriction: Must be dedicated to the service of a goddess through an order.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9th level, hit dice do not increase; add +1 hit point per level.

general_notes.rule: Hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored.
May use any magic item usable by clerics.

weapons.rule: Permitted weapons: quarterstaff, club, dagger, dart.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw starts at 10+ against AC 0.
Attack throws improve by 2 every 6 levels.
Saving throws improve by 2 every 4 levels.

access_rules.rule: Begins casting divine spells at 1st level.
Spells are granted through prayer and worship.
Spell availability by level is determined by the class spell progression table.

ritual_access.rule: At 11th level, may learn and cast 6th and 7th level ritual divine spells.

casting_limits.rule: To use spells and turn undead, the priestess must uphold the strictures of her order and goddess.
If the Judge has not specified orders, the default order is the Keepers of the Hearth Fire devoted to Mityara.

Default strictures: wear the order's white mantles and shawls in public; keep a flame lit throughout every seventh night; refrain from taking human or demi-human life; remain chaste and celibate until reaching 7th level.
Beastmen, undead, and other monsters are not protected by the non-killing stricture.
If the priestess falls from favor, the Judge may impose penalties such as attack penalties or reduced spell access.

turning.definition: Turn undead as a cleric of equal level.

rules.rule: There is no daily limit on turning attempts.
If a turning attempt fails during an encounter, the priestess cannot attempt to turn undead again for the rest of that encounter.

ability.name: turn_undead
ability.summary: Turn undead as a cleric of equal level.

rules.rule: No daily limit.
A failed turning attempt blocks further turning attempts for the remainder of that encounter.

ability.name: magic_research_minor
ability.summary: May research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

ability.name: matriarchal_magic_item_creation
ability.summary: May create magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

ability.name: ritual_divine_magic_and_constructs
ability.summary: May access higher divine ritual practice and advanced crafting.

rules.rule: May learn and cast 6th and 7th level ritual divine spells.
May craft magical constructs such as golems and animated statues.
May perform necromancy if Chaotic.

ability.name: cloister_foundation
ability.summary: May establish or build a cloister.

rules.rule: If the priestess has had a good and noble adventuring career, the matriarch of her present cloister may pay up to 100% of the construction cost of a modest cloister.
The new cloister usually remains a branch of the original cloister until the priestess reaches 12th level, then becomes independent.
When founded, the cloister attracts 1d2x10 1st level priestesses and 1d6x30 normal women who wish to become priestesses.
Each year, 80% of the previous year's trainees leave, and 1d6x20 normal women arrive as replacements.
A normal woman in training usually requires 2 years to become a 1st level priestess.

acquisition_rules.rule: May establish or build a cloister.
If the priestess has had a good and noble adventuring career, her current matriarch may fund up to 100% of the construction cost of a modest cloister.
The new cloister usually remains a branch of the older cloister until 12th level, then becomes independent.

cost_rules.rule: 80% of the previous year's trainees leave each year.
A normal woman in training usually requires 2 years to become a 1st level priestess.

general_notes.rule: Hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored.
May use any magic item usable by clerics.

fighting_styles.rule: May fight with a weapon two-handed.

Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 every 4 levels.

access_rules.rule: Begins casting divine spells at 2nd level.
Spells are granted through careful morning rituals.

ritual_access.rule: At 11th level, may learn and cast 6th and 7th level ritual divine spells.

casting_limits.rule: At 3rd level and higher, spiritual ritual can recover one expended spell level, but the same spell level cannot be recovered more than once per day.

custom_subsystem.name: totem_animal
custom_subsystem.definition: A totem animal physically represents the shaman's relationship with sacred powers.

rules.rule: At 1st level, choose a totem animal appropriate to the character's tribe and abilities.
The shaman must have at least 9 in the totem animal's key ability score.
The totem animal's Intelligence equals half the shaman's Intelligence.
The totem animal understands the shaman's speech, and the shaman understands the totem animal's speech.
Others cannot understand the totem animal without speak with animals.
So long as the shaman upholds tribal traditions, the totem animal is utterly loyal and will fight, perform services, and obey commands.
While the totem animal is alive, the shaman gains its totem benefit.
Because the totem animal is partly the shaman's own spirit, it always has HD and maximum hit points equal to half the shaman's own.
If the totem animal has fewer HD than normal for its species, it appears smaller or younger and deals 1 less point on each damage die, minimum 1.
If the totem animal has more HD than normal for its species, it appears larger and stronger, up to twice normal size, and deals +1 damage on each damage die.
The totem animal saves as a cleric of half the shaman's level.
If the totem animal is killed, the shaman must save versus Death or immediately take damage equal to the totem animal's maximum hit points.
A slain totem animal cannot be restored to life or reincarnated.
If a totem animal is slain, a new totem animal of the same type appears the next time the shaman gains a level.
Except where modified by class rules, the totem animal otherwise has the characteristics of a normal animal of its type.
The source's example indicates at least some totem benefits function while the shaman is within 30' of the totem animal.

row.value: Move 120', AC 3, HD 4, #AT 3, Dmg 1d3/1d3/1d6, bear hug
Move 480' fly, AC 1, HD 1, #AT 2, Dmg 1d2/1d2, swoop attack
Move 240', AC 2, HD 2, #AT 2, Dmg 1d4/1d4, can be ridden
Move 300', AC 1, HD 1/2, #AT 1, Dmg 1d2, night vision, +3 to surprise
Move 90', AC 3, HD 2, #AT 1, Dmg 1d4+poison, always has initiative

ability.name: commune_with_ancestral_spirits
ability.summary: Ask ancestral spirits questions.

procedure.step: During the ritual, the shaman is out of body and helpless.

rules.rule: The spirits answer to the best of their ability.
The spirits are wise but not omniscient, and may answer inaccurately.
Once each year on a sacred day determined by the Judge, the shaman may ask twice the normal number of questions without angering the spirits.

ability.name: divine_spellcasting
ability.summary: Begins casting divine spells.

ability.name: spiritual_ritual
ability.summary: Recover one expended spell level.

procedure.step: Perform an ecstatic ritual lasting 1 hour (6 turns).
Recover the ability to cast one spell level that has already been expended.

limits.limit: May be performed as often as desired.
The same spell level cannot be regained more than once per day.

ability.name: shapechange
ability.summary: Assume totem animal form.

rules.rule: Begins at 5th level.
The shaman remains in the new form until changing back.
A 5th level shaman can shapechange once per day.
Each additional class level grants one additional shapechange per day.
Changing shape can be done in combat in place of making an attack.
In totem form, use the movement, AC, attacks, damage, and powers from the Totem Animals table.
The shaman retains normal hit dice, hit points, attack throws, and saving throws.
If the shaman has more HD than the normal animal type, the form appears larger and stronger, up to twice normal size, and each damage die increases by +1.
Apart from size, the form is indistinguishable from a normal animal.
The form does not detect as magical, is not detected by illusion-revealing spells, and cannot be dispelled.

ability.name: spiritwalk
ability.summary: Send spirit from body.

procedure.step: Enter a trance and release the spirit from the body.
Remain spiritwalking until the spirit returns or until 1 hour per level has elapsed.

rules.rule: The spirit may assume human or totem animal shape.
In either shape, the spirit sees and hears normally, moves at that shape's normal movement rate, and passes through solid objects.
The spirit cannot see into, hear from, or move through areas warded by antimagic shell, protection from evil, or similar effects.
The spirit is incorporeal and invisible.
The spirit can be detected by detect invisible or true seeing.
If detected, the spirit can be harmed by spells and magic weapons.
Dispel evil forces the spirit to return to the body.
If the body is destroyed, the shaman dies at the end of the spiritwalk.
If the spirit is destroyed, the body falls into a catatonic slumber that can be ended only by restore life and limb, resurrection, or wish.

ability.name: medicine_lodge
ability.summary: May establish or build a medicine lodge and attract tribal followers.

rules.rule: If currently in favor with tribal powers, may buy or build the medicine lodge at half the normal price due to divine intervention.
Once established, attracts 5d6x10 0th level tribesmen armed with various weapons and 1d6 shamans of 1st-3rd level of the same tribe.
Followers are completely loyal, with morale +4.
Followers must be provided food and lodging but need not be paid wages.

ability.summary: May research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions.

ability.name: magic_research_major
ability.summary: May create more powerful magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

Cast spells as a mage of two thirds class level.
Spell selection is limited to the warlock's repertoire.

repertoire_rules.rule: The repertoire may contain a number of spells up to the number and level of spells listed for the warlock's class level, increased by Intelligence bonus.

casting_limits.rule: Per-day spell slots are determined by the Warlock spell progression table.
The spell progression table in the provided source excerpt is malformed, so individual slot values cannot be recovered from the excerpt with confidence.

custom_subsystem.name: familiar
custom_subsystem.definition: Each warlock begins play with a familiar appropriate to alignment and spell signature.

rules.rule: The familiar's HD and maximum hit points equal half the warlock's.
The familiar's Intelligence equals the warlock's Intelligence.
The familiar has as many general and class proficiencies as the warlock, selected from the warlock's class list.
The familiar understands any languages spoken by the warlock.
The warlock understands the familiar's speech.
Others cannot understand the familiar without speak with animals.
The familiar is utterly loyal and will fight, perform services, and obey commands.
While the familiar is within 30', the warlock gains +1 on saving throws.
If the familiar is killed, the warlock must save versus Death or immediately take damage equal to the familiar's maximum total hit points.
If the familiar is slain, a new familiar is gained the next time the warlock earns a level.

ability.name: familiar
ability.summary: Gain a loyal familiar.

ability.name: secrets_of_the_dark_arts
ability.summary: Unlock dark magical advantages.

rules.rule: May control undead as a Chaotic cleric of half class level.
Targets of the warlock's spells that allow a saving throw versus Death suffer a -2 penalty on the save.
Necromantic spell effects are calculated as though the warlock were 2 levels higher than actual caster level.

ability.name: hex
ability.summary: Place a curse on a visible target within 30'.

procedure.step: Choose a target creature the warlock can see within 30'.
Target makes a saving throw versus Spells.
If the save fails, choose one hex effect.

rules.rule: Hex options: -4 to one ability score, minimum 1; -4 on attack throws and saving throws; halve prime requisite, minimum 1; or each combat round, 50% chance to act normally and otherwise take no action.
A hex cannot be dispelled.
Remove curse removes the hex.

ability.name: contact_dark_powers
ability.summary: Contact demons and evil spirits.

procedure.step: Resolve the effect as contact other plane.

rules.rule: The beings contacted possess near-omniscience but the contact can be mind-shattering.

ability.name: magic_research_minor
ability.summary: May research spells, scribe scrolls, and brew potions as a 5th level mage.

ability.name: alter_shape
ability.summary: Assume the shape of any humanoid creature.

rules.rule: May alter physical qualities such as height, weight, gender, hair color, hair texture, and skin color within the normal range for the chosen humanoid kind.
Equipment remains worn or held where possible and otherwise melds into the new form.
The form lasts 6 turns plus 1 turn per level above 8th.
Changing shape can be performed during combat in place of making an attack.

limits.limit: May be used no more than once every 8 hours.

ability.name: coterie
ability.summary: May establish a coterie and attract apprentices.

rules.rule: A coterie is usually established in a remote and desolate location.
Attracts 1d6 apprentices of 1st-3rd level and 2d6 normal men seeking to become warlocks.
Prospective warlocks have above-average Intelligence.
Many quit after 1d6 months due to fear of the required sacrifices.
Apprentices must be provided food and lodging but need not be paid wages.
If the warlock builds a dungeon beneath or near the coterie, monsters begin arriving to dwell there, followed by adventurers seeking them.
The coterie is otherwise mechanically identical to a mage's sanctum.

ability.name: summon_infernal_creature
ability.summary: Summon a Chaotic servant.

procedure.step: Summon an invisible stalker or another Chaotic creature devised by the Judge.

rules.rule: The summoned creature serves until dispel evil is cast on it, it is slain, or its task is fulfilled.
Infernal creatures resent being summoned and may pervert instructions if the task is lengthy or dangerous.

ability.name: magic_research_and_necromancy
ability.summary: Advanced magic item creation and necromancy.

rules.rule: May create items such as weapons, rings, and staffs as a 9th level mage.
May cast ritual spells of a necromantic nature and create necromantic servants as an 11th level mage.

ability.name: forbidden_spells
ability.summary: Add forbidden spells to the warlock class list.

rules.rule: Add to class spell list: 3rd level cause disease and speak with dead; 4th level cause serious wounds; 5th level finger of death.
These spells are arcane for warlocks but otherwise identical to their divine counterparts.
A scroll containing one of these spells is usable only by divine casters who have the spell on their class list, or by 14th level warlocks.
Lower-level warlocks and standard mages cannot use such scrolls or cast these spells, because they are not on their class spell list.

acquisition_rules.rule: A coterie is usually established in a remote and desolate location.
If a dungeon is built beneath or near the coterie, monsters begin arriving there, followed by adventurers seeking them.
The coterie is otherwise identical to a mage's sanctum.

Many normal men quit after 1d6 months.

casting_limits.rule: Each witch must belong to a tradition chosen at character creation.
Each tradition adds spells to the witch class list and grants abilities at 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 7th level.
Magic research is performed as a cleric of equal level.

custom_subsystem.name: traditions
custom_subsystem.definition: Each witch selects one tradition at creation; the tradition modifies spell access and grants level-based powers.

rules.rule: Record the selected tradition and all granted spells and powers when the character is created.

option.name: antiquarian
option.rule: Add bonus spells: 1st detect poison; 2nd delay poison; 3rd cure disease; 4th cure serious wounds.
1st level: gain one rank of Healing proficiency.
3rd level: may cure moderate wounds by touch once every 8 hours; each use takes 1 turn.
5th level: gain one rank of Alchemy proficiency.
7th level: may neutralize poison once per day; each use takes 1 turn.

option.name: chthonic
option.rule: Add bonus spells: 1st detect undead; 2nd spiritual weapon; 3rd necromantic potence; 4th animate dead.
1st level: gain Seduction proficiency.
3rd level: gain Black Lore of Zahar proficiency.
5th level: gain Mystic Aura proficiency.
7th level: may charm person once per day; each use takes 1 round.

option.name: sylvan
option.rule: Add bonus spells: 2nd obscuring cloud and silent step; 3rd glitterdust; 4th summon animals.
1st level: gain Beast Friendship proficiency.
3rd level: may change shape as a warlock once per day; each use takes 1 turn.
5th level: gain Passing Without Trace proficiency.
7th level: may polymorph self once per week; each use takes 1 turn.

option.name: voudon
option.rule: Add bonus spells: 1st detect undead; 2nd holy chant; 3rd prayer; 4th smite undead.
1st level: gain one Craft proficiency of choice.
3rd level: may turn undead as a cleric of half class level.
3rd level: fear-inflicting spells are calculated as though the witch were 2 class levels higher, and are resisted with a -2 penalty on the saving throw.
5th level: may perform spiritual rituals as a shaman.
7th level: gain mastery of charms and illusions identical to an elven enchanter.
